description.value: Kozak is a Ukrainian homestyle eatery on Vancouver's Victoria Drive serving scratch-made traditional dishes. The neighbourhood spot has an active online ordering presence through Square, suggesting food is available for takeaway as well as dine-in. It is a community-rooted business in a cycling-friendly corridor of East Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully but the captured content is almost entirely a cookie-consent/tracking disclosure page, yielding little actionable amenity data beyond confirming the site is live and uses Square's online-ordering platform (evidenced by the 'order-online:selected-location' Square cookie), which implies takeout capability. OSM tags confirm the restaurant is open with regular hours and is not flagged as closed. The website title 'Kozak Homemade Ukrainian Food' differs slightly from the OSM name 'Kozak Ukraїnian Eatery', which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Website title reads 'Kozak Homemade Ukrainian Food' while OSM name is 'Kozak Ukraїnian Eatery' — minor branding discrepancy worth verifying.
Website content was almost entirely a cookie-consent overlay; substantive amenity details (washrooms, bike parking, menu options) could not be confirmed from the captured text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Ukrainian restaurant in Vancouver with an active website and OSM record showing regular hours; useful stop for touring cyclists on Victoria Drive.
